## macchie/, fumo/ — Kenney (CC0)

Splat Pack (macchie/), Smoke Particles e Particle Pack (fumo/): www.kenney.nl,
Creative Commons Zero (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

## suoni/ — Kenney e OpenGameArt (CC0)

- tonfo, morbido, schiaffo, legno, vetro, metallo, piatto: «Impact Sounds»,
  Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0.
- splat, squish, pop: «Squish Sounds Effects», EZduzziteh,
  https://opengameart.org/content/squish-sounds-effects, CC0.
- botto, petardo, boom: «Explosions», EZduzziteh,
  https://opengameart.org/node/115744, CC0.
- urlo, strillo: «Female high-pitched scream SFX», WuxiaScrub,
  https://opengameart.org/content/female-high-pitched-scream-sfx, CC0.

I suoni sono tagliati e portati allo stesso volume massimo (-1 dBFS).
